value.rationale: The 2026 counterexample reopens a natural precise geometric extremal question and asks whether its convenient parameters can be improved. The complete unique optimizer over the full nonnegative-amplitude two-parameter curvature-constrained quadrant is structurally motivated, quantitatively lifts the example from 0.7862156 and the published fixed-angle value 0.7871835 to 0.7888437886, and proves that the optimum is at curvature saturation and a unique nontrivial angle. No claim of the global reduced-body optimum is made.
